exercises.title: Planguage 1 — what does each keyword mean?
exercises.problemHtml:
Tom Gilb’s Planguage, used by Wiegers to write precise quality requirements. Match each description to its keyword.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Planguage 1 — what does each keyword mean? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: TAG
   - r1.k: AMBITION
   - r2.k: SCALE
   - r3.k: METER
   - r4.k: GOAL
   - r5.k: STRETCH
   - r6.k: WISH
   - r7.k: PAST
   - r8.k: DEFINED
   SCALE says WHAT is measured; METER says HOW it is measured; GOAL is the must-reach level; STRETCH and WISH are higher, optional levels.

exercises.title: Planguage 2 — read a Planguage requirement
exercises.problemHtml:
TAG: Booking.Speed
AMBITION: Patients can confirm an appointment quickly on a phone.
SCALE: Seconds from tapping "Confirm" to the confirmation screen.
METER: Automated test of 500 bookings on a 4G connection, 90th percentile.
GOAL: ≤ 3 seconds
STRETCH: ≤ 2 seconds
WISH: ≤ 1 second
PAST: 6 seconds (old web form)

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Planguage 2 — read a Planguage requirement — answer key

1. The release measures 2.6 s. Is the requirement satisfied?Bản phát hành đo được 2,6 giây. Đạt yêu cầu không?
   Answer: a) Yes — the GOAL (≤ 3 s) is met; STRETCH is not
   Only GOAL is mandatory.VI: Chỉ GOAL là bắt buộc.

2. Which line tells the tester how to measure?Dòng nào cho tester biết đo thế nào?
   Answer: c) METER
   METER is the measuring method.VI: METER là phương pháp đo.

3. The word "quickly" appears in AMBITION. Is that a problem?AMBITION có chữ "quickly". Có sao không?
   Answer: a) No — AMBITION states intent; SCALE, METER and GOAL make it precise
   The precision lives in the other keywords.VI: Độ chính xác nằm ở các từ khoá khác.

exercises.title: Planguage 3 — write and check a Planguage requirement
exercises.problemHtml:
Two parts. (a) Write PL, a Planguage requirement for the availability of a hospital booking service ("always up") as an object with keys TAG, AMBITION, SCALE, METER, GOAL, STRETCH (strings). GOAL and STRETCH must contain a percentage and STRETCH must be stricter than GOAL. (b) Write function meets(pl, measured) that returns "goal", "stretch" or "fail" for a measured percentage, reading the numbers from pl.GOAL and pl.STRETCH (for availability, higher is better; a value equal to the level meets it). It will be tested on hidden Planguage objects too.

Requirements

  • meets() returns "stretch" when the STRETCH level is reached, else "goal" when the GOAL is reached, else "fail".
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
(a) Viết PL — yêu cầu Planguage về độ sẵn sàng ("luôn chạy") với các khoá TAG, AMBITION, SCALE, METER, GOAL, STRETCH; GOAL và STRETCH có phần trăm, STRETCH chặt hơn GOAL. (b) Viết meets(pl, measured) trả "goal", "stretch" hoặc "fail", đọc số từ pl.GOAL và pl.STRETCH (cao hơn là tốt hơn; bằng mức thì đạt mức đó). Có kiểm trên dữ liệu ẩn.

Yêu cầu

  • meets() trả "stretch" nếu đạt STRETCH, không thì "goal" nếu đạt GOAL, còn lại "fail".

examplesJson.explanation: Above the goal, below the stretch.|||Trên goal, dưới stretch.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Planguage separates the intent (AMBITION) from the measurement (SCALE + METER) and the target levels (GOAL, STRETCH, WISH). Only GOAL is the acceptance threshold.

moTa.vi: PL có đủ sáu từ khoá

'missing: ' : 'error: ') + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } })();
